### S6  the conflict is semantic, and it is the empty-payload wording ###
Trunk wording kept by the 389 line:
  44:const ZERO_BYTES_NOTICE =
  45-  "[the tool delivered an empty payload: zero bytes of output]";
  46-
The 388 remediation replaces that single notice with a two-reason table:
  75:const EMPTY_NOTICES = {
  76-  "zero-bytes": "[the tool delivered an empty payload: zero bytes of output]",
  77-  "no-content-blocks":
  78-    "[the runtime recorded a tool result with no content blocks: no text was delivered, and this site cannot tell a tool that produced none from a payload that never arrived]",
  79-} as const;
  80-
  81-type EmptyReason = keyof typeof EMPTY_NOTICES;
Both sides insert an ENVELOPE_DELIMITER block at the same place in the file.

  |  * `USER:`, `ASSISTANT:` and `TOOL RESULT (<name>):`. Only the `:` that makes the

### GATE S BRANCH TAKEN — G3 ###
Three measurements, and G1 and G2 each need a separate premise killed:
S1 (G1 is out): the 388 remediation's patch-id is '+' against trunk AND '+'
    against the 389 line, so no commit of one is already carried by the other
    and nothing is subsumed. S5 says the same from the other side: 119 added
    and 295 removed lines across three files between the two tips, including
    the 202-line tool-channel-authority.test.ts that exists on only one side.
S4 (G2 is out): merge-tree between the two lines exits rc=1 with CONFLICT
    (content) in packages/pi-claude-cli/src/tool-result-authority.ts, so they
    cannot simply be stacked on each other. S6 gives the reason: both sides
    rewrite the same empty-payload declaration and both insert an
    ENVELOPE_DELIMITER block at the same position.
S4b: each line on its own merges clean against trunk (rc=0), so exactly one
    line is deliverable by this card without a human choice.
=> G3: deliver the clean line (the STAS-389 frame + role-key invariant),
   rebase it onto trunk, and hand the revoke-or-resolve choice for the
   STAS-388 remediation to the operator as a written decision request.
   'Clean line' here means the conflict-free one against trunk, not the
   semantically better one — that ranking is the operator's call.
S6: the neutraliser symbols appear 7 times in the module at the 389 tip
    and only 2 times at the 388 tip, so revoking the 388 line loses no
    frame-integrity code that the 389 line does not already carry.
